question: Why do the objectors fail to understand the nature of peaceful Shiva?
premises: The objectors are devoid of the essence of the flashing of their own awareness.
Because of this, they do not know the truth.
Peaceful Shiva is not some differentiated entity.
inference: Lacking the living essence of self-awareness, the objectors misconceive peaceful Shiva as a differentiated thing.
plain_english: They do not know, because they are devoid of the essence of the flashing of their own awareness. For this peaceful Shiva is not some differentiated entity.
